policies.n: Territory-dependent permission, not a Palestinian visa requirement. Gaza is not covered by a routine Israeli admission entitlement: Erez is reported closed and Rafah extremely restricted. Palestinian population-register status changes the permitted airport/crossing route even when using a Canadian passport; registered Palestinians may not enter through Ben Gurion under the stated guidance, and dual-national treatment requires individual confirmation. Passport validity more than six months and yellow-fever vaccination apply. The source states one-to-three-month visa validity, not a verified stay allowance.
